ngo5 teng1 dou2 jau5 cyun4 jin4 waa6 gung1 si1 zau6 zap1.
eng: I heard a rumour that the company is closing.

fun1 jing4 duk6 ze2 cyun4 jyut6.
eng: We welcome readers to share and circulate this.

yue: 人與人之間傳播嘅消息，但又冇辦法證實嘅（量詞：個／段）

jau5 cyun4 man4 waa6 ging1 lei5 wui5 ci4 zik1 wo5.

yue: 向大眾傳播訊息嘅媒介嘅統稱；好似

yue: tung1 zi1 cyun4 mui4 zou6 fong2 man6.
eng: Inform the media to conduct an interview.

yue: 由法定機構發出既信件，具法律效力，用黎要求收信人出席聆訊，主要見於法庭同紀律聆訊委員會等（量詞：張）
eng: summons; a legal document issued by a competent authority or institution (usually a court or government body), primarily to compel the recipient to show up for legal or disciplinary proceedings

ngo5 ji5 ging1 zoeng1 ngo5 so2 sik1 ge3 je5 cyun4 bou6 cyun4 sau6 zo2 bei2 nei5
eng: I have already taught you all that I know.

yue: cyun4 seon3 kap6 gung1 gung6 si6 mou6 cyu3
用嚟聽對方講嘢嘅部份

figuratively, a mouthpiece, someone who merely relays a message for another party

eng: After spending so much time and money on your education, you're now involved in a pyramid scheme? What a waste of an education!

yue: 指將一啲資料或者信息由一個地方轉移去另一個地方。
有咗光纖，傳送訊息更快捷。
jau5 zo2 gwong1 cim1, cyun4 sung3 seon3 sik1 gang1 faai3 zit3
eng: With fibre optics, information can be transferred even more rapidly.

yue: 代替人向其他人轉達佢嘅訊息

keoi5 baa2 seng1 saa1 zo2, ngo5 bong1 keoi5 cyun4 waa6.
eng: Her voice has got hoarse. I speak for her.

yue: 係咪老細叫你同我傳話㗎？
hai6 mai6 lou5 sai3 giu3 nei5 tung4 ngo5 cyun4 waa6 gaa3?
eng: Did the boss ask you to pass on his message to me?

yue: ；多數係指生育男嘅小朋友去繼承家族，因為傳統上嚟講只有男性先可以將姓氏傳落下一代
eng: to produce offspring; usually, to produce a male heir to continue the family line

aa3 maa1 waa6 dak1 ngo5 jat1 nap1 zai2, cyun4 zung1 zip3 doi6 zau6 kaau3 saai3 ngo5 wo5.
eng: Mom said she has only me as a son. The continuation of our family line is on me.

yue: 名留青史嘅英雄會畀人傳誦。
ming4 lau4 cing1 si2 ge3 jing1 hung4 wui5 bei2 jan4 cyun4 zung6.
eng: The names of renowned heroes will be eternally celebrated.

yue: 你年紀輕輕，竟然詮釋《莊子》嘅思想詮釋得咁好，幾犀利喎。
nei5 nin4 gei2 heng1 heng1 ging2 jin4 cyun4 sik1 zong1 zi2 ge3 si1 soeng2 cyun4 sik1 dak1 gam3 hou2, gei2 sai1 lei6 wo3.
eng: It is amazing that you are able to interpret the philosophy of Chuang Tzu at such a young age.

eng: to be assertive and aggressive in speech; to be overbearing; to compel somebody by speech

yue: 我已經話咗我冇偷你嘢，你唔好再咄咄逼人嚹喎！
ngo5 ji5 ging1 waa6 zo2 ngo5 mou5 tau1 nei5 je5, nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 cyut3 cyut3 bik1 jan4 laa3 wo3!

cam4 jat6 jau6 jau5 jan4 fan3 fan3 haa2 gaau3 cyut3 sei2 zo2 aa3!
eng: Yet another one suddenly died in his sleep yesterday!

yue: 排除因為自殺、他殺或事故而發病，病人喺出現病徵後好快就死咗
阿松佢連續五日五夜打機冇瞓，第六日朝頭早猝死咗。
aa3 cung4 keoi5 lin4 zuk6 ng5 jat6 ng5 je6 daa2 gei1 mou5 fan3, dai6 luk6 jat6 ziu1 tau4 zou2 cyut3 sei2 zo2.
eng: A-chung had been playing video games without sleep for five days and nights. He died suddenly on the sixth morning.

yue: 將兩個人拉埋一齊，令到佢哋識得對方
eng: to match, especially a pair of lovers

yue: 佢兩個咪就係我撮合㗎囉。
keoi5 loeng5 go3 mai6 zau6 hai6 ngo5 cyut3 hap6 gaa3 lo1.
eng: It's me who matched these two up.

yue: 對一篇文章要點嘅簡短描述
，死刑嘅其中一種；引申為判死刑嘅意思
eng: to execute by shooting or firing squad; also means receiving capital punishment in general by extension

ni1 di1 waai6 jan4 zeoi3 hou2 zau6 hai6 zuk1 keoi5 dei6 heoi3 daa2 baa2 laak3.

yue: 金融用語，指期貨、期權、窩輪或牛熊證因到期或觸發行使價而除牌

yue: 無喇，之前買落嘅輪都打晒靶。
mou5 laa3, zi1 cin4 maai5 lok6 ge3 leon2 dou1 daa2 saai3 baa2.
eng: Oh no, all warrants in my portfolio were called.

bat1 ceot1 saam1 fan1 zung1, keoi5 zau6 daa2 baai6 zo2 deoi3 sau2 laak3.
eng: He defeated his opponent within three minutes.

yue: 我又俾病菌打敗喇，好唔舒服呀。
ngo5 jau6 bei2 beng6 kwan2 daa2 baai6 laa3, hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6 aa3.
eng: I've caught a bug again. I'm feeling really sick now.

yue: 修飾一個人嘅外表，令佢變得更靚、更吸引

to pack up the remains of a meal when one eats out so that they can be brought to home

sik6 zing6 zo2 gam3 do1 je5, ling1 go3 doi2 daa2 baau1 ling1 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa1.
eng: There is so much food left, let's take a doggy bag and bring them home.

eng: to wrap a corpse and prepare it in a mortuary just after a person died in a hospital so that it is kept and can be examined before the funeral

gei3 ze2 heoi3 dou3 ji1 jyun2 go2 si2, gu1 noeng4 ji5 ging1 tung4 sei2 ze2 daa2 zo2 baau1, sung3 zo2 jap6 lim5 fong4 laak3.
eng: The nurse has already wrapped the dead body with a shroud and sent it to the mortuary before the reporters arrived.

yue: 瞓覺時因為呼吸受阻，令呼吸道結構嘅軟組織振動而發出聲音；通常喺睡眠不足或者有睡眠窒息症時發生，當事人一般都唔知道同埋控制唔到

；因為個個隻手好似用筷子攁下攁下同埋人群中間有煙升起，狀似一班人圍埋一齊打邊爐而引申出呢個意思

ng5 faan6 si4 gaan3 ngoi6 min6 laap6 saap3 tung2 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4 daa2 bin1 lou4.

yue: sing1 kei4 jat6 dak1 m4 dak1 haan4 daa2 bo1?

bou6 hei3 seoi2 gei1 daa2 zo2 caai4, jiu3 giu3 jan4 lei4 zing2.

令一樣嘢傾側、偏向一邊、唔再處於水平或垂直嘅狀態

to be stripped to the waist; literally: to expose big naked armpit

daai6 jit6 tin1 si4, go3 go3 daa2 bo1 dou1 daa2 daai6 cek3 laak3 gaa3 laa1.
eng: Everybody takes off their shirts when playing basketball in the hot summer.

send; assign; dispatch (like somebody on an errand)

、酒精或汽油，靠磨擦點火；又可以簡稱做

can4 si1 naai1 sing4 jat6 maai5 sung3 daa2 fu2 tau4, cou5 cou5 maai4 maai4 dou1 m4 siu2 cin2 gaa3.

yue: 兩個或以上嘅人彼此攻擊對方嘅身體

gam1 ci3 ngo5 dei6 zan1 hai6 jiu3 dang2 tin1 daa2 gau3 laa3.

ngo5 bat1 si6 bat1 hoi1 sam1, zi2 si6 jau2 dim2 sat1 mong6 ji4 ji5.
yue: 我唔係唔開心，只係有啲失望啫。
ngo5 m4 hai6 m4 hoi1 sam1, zi2 hai6 jau5 di1 sat1 mong6 ze1.
eng: I ain't unhappy. I'm just a little bit disappointed.

yue: 臨牀醫學嘅專科之一，主要處理小朋友同未成年嘅人有關嘅疾病
keoi5 hai6 ji4 fo1 ji1 sang1.
唱畀兒童聽嘅歌；一般旋律、歌詞簡單，適合小朋友收聽（量詞：首／隻／支）
ngo5 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 dou1 coeng3 ji4 go1.
eng: I used to sing nursery rhymes always when I was small.

yue: 呢首兒歌好出名，大人細路都識。
ni1 sau2 ji4 go1 hou2 ceot1 meng2, daai6 jan4 sai3 lou6 dou1 sik1.
eng: This nursery rhyme is very famous that adults and kids know it.

yue: 形容做事態度求其、唔認真、唔負責任，好似細路仔
eng: frivolous; not earnest; irresponsible; childish (in terms of responsibility); not taking a serious attitude when working on an important task; literally: "child's play"

yue: 呢件事好重要，唔可以咁兒戲。
ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 zung6 jiu3, m4 ho2 ji5 gam3 ji4 hei1.
eng: This is an important matter. We can't act frivolously.

yue: 你對愛情咁兒戲，我好難同你行落去喎。
nei5 deoi3 oi3 cing4 gam3 ji4 hei1, ngo5 hou2 naan4 tung4 nei5 haang4 lok6 heoi3 wo3.
eng: You are so irresponsible when it comes to love. It's so hard for me to continue my relationship with you.

yue: 形容物件整得唔硬淨，好易爛
eng: poorly made; fragile; liable to break

yue: 張櫈咁兒嬉㗎，一坐就冧！
zoeng1 dang3 gam3 ji4 hei1 gaa3, jat1 co5 zau6 lam3!
eng: This chair is so fragile. It collapses as soon as anybody sits on it.

zho: ngo5 dik1 ji4 sik1 deoi3 ngo5 han2 hou2.
yue: ngo5 san1 pou5 deoi3 ngo5 hou2 hou2.
ji4 tung4 jing1 goi1 sau6 dou3 bou2 wu6.
專家話只要做多啲訓練，佢好大機會成為資優兒童。
zyun1 gaa1 waa6 zi2 jiu3 zou6 do1 di1 fan3 lin6, keoi5 hou2 daai6 gei1 wui6 sing4 wai4 zi1 jau1 ji4 tung4
eng: Experts say that given more training, there's a good chance that she will become a gifted child.

yue: 唔適合小朋友，通常指有色情或者血腥暴力

eng: This film is not suitable for children.

yue: 香港嘅兒童節係四月四號，而國際兒童節係六月一號。兒童節唔係香港嘅法定假期。家長通常會喺呢日送禮物俾小朋友。
兒童節係小朋友最鍾意嘅節日。
ji4 tung4 zit3 hai6 siu2 pang4 jau5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 zit3 jat6.
eng: Children's day is the favourite festival of children.

zho: taa1 si6 ngo5 dik1 ji4 zi2.

yue: 形容某個環境好適合人留係果度
呢度啲天氣令人好舒服。

eng: rather; let (used when expressing a wish, a curse, etc.)
He wants you to get away now.

yue: 一個身體器官，用嚟分泌胰島素
令原本係一個地方嘅嘢去咗另一個地方嘅動作
eng: to move; to remove; to shift

yue: 我哋一齊移走呢個箱啦。
ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 ji4 zau2 ni1 go3 soeng1 laa1.
eng: Let's move the box away together.

yue: 唔再愛一個人，而改為愛另一個人
eng: to turn one's back on his lover and go with another

yue: 一對戀人分隔兩地，好可能其中一方會移情別戀㗎。
jat1 deoi3 lyun2 jan4 fan1 gaak3 loeng5 dei6, hou2 ho2 nang4 kei4 zung1 jat1 fong1 wui5 ji4 cing4 bit6 lyun2 gaa3.
eng: If a couple lives separately and apart, it is possible that one of them will dump another for someone else.

yue: ；原本喺一個地方嘅嘢去咗另一個地方
laang5 hung1 hei3 zing3 hoeng3 naam4 ji4 dung6.
eng: The cold air mass is moving southward.

yue: 將一樣嘢交俾另一個人或者團體
香港主權喺一九九七年由英國移交畀中國。
hoeng1 gong2 zyu2 kyun4 hai2 jat1 gau2 gau2 cat1 nin4 jau4 jing1 gwok3 ji4 gaau1 bei2 zung1 gwok3.
eng: The sovereignty of Hong Kong was transferred from the United Kingdom to China in 1997.

yue: 由原本住嘅地方搬咗去另一個地方住，可以指係同一個國家唔同地區之間嘅搬遷
keoi5 lai4 gan2 wui5 ji4 geoi1 heoi3 jat6 bun2.
eng: She is going to move to Japan.

yue: 一個人或者一堆人由一個地方走去另一個地方，引申為一個活動嘅舉行地點由一個地方變做另一個地方
eng: to move/shift; to be relocated to

yue: 由於天雨關係，比賽會移師到室內舉行。
jau4 jyu1 tin1 jyu5 gwaan1 hai6, bei2 coi3 wui5 ji4 si1 dou3 sat1 noi6 geoi2 hang4.
eng: The competition is relocated to indoors because of the heavy rain.

yue: 某啲物件由一個位置變咗去另一個位置
eng: to shift in location; to dislocate

yue: 你再係咁唔小心，你個膝頭會再次移位。
eng: If you keep being careless, your knee will dislocate again.

yue: 將植物由一個地方搬去另一個地方繼續種
我將啲樹移植咗去隔籬。
eng: I transplanted those trees to the area next door.

yue: 將一個個體嘅某一個器官成個或者部分噉轉移去另一個體，或者同一個個體嘅另一部份

eng: This is a successful organ transplant.

yue: 將軟體由一個環境移去另一個環境繼續運行

eng: to enjoy something bitter as if it is something sweet; to endure hardship gladly

yue: 唔相信某啲嘢，對某啲嘢抱有問題
eng: to doubt; to disbelieve; to suspect

yue: 解釋唔通，有問題，唔清楚嘅地方（量詞：個）
ni1 daan1 on3 jau5 m4 siu2 ji4 dim2.
eng: This case has many questionable points.

yue: 有犯傷人或者殺人罪嫌疑嘅人；傷人、殺人罪行嘅
eng: suspect of an assault or a murder

yue: 佢係呢單傷人案嘅疑兇。
keoi5 hai6 ni1 daan1 soeng1 jan4 on3 ge3 ji4 hung1.
eng: He is the suspect in this assault.

yue: 擔心某啲問題會發生嘅諗法（量詞：個）
佢嘅答覆消除咗我嘅疑慮。
keoi5 ge3 daap3 fuk1 siu1 ceoi4 zo2 ngo5 ge3 ji4 leoi6.
eng: His answer resolved all our doubts.

yue: 如果有任何疑問，可以打電話俾我。
jyu4 gwo2 jau5 jam6 ho4 ji4 man6, ho2 ji5 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 ngo5.
eng: Please feel free to call me if you have any inquiries.

yue: 有疑惑、難以判斷或處理嘅情況
即使遇到疑難，我哋都唔應該放棄。
zik1 si2 jyu6 dou2 ji4 naan4, ngo5 dei6 dou1 m4 jing1 goi1 fong3 hei3.
eng: We should not give up even when we come up with difficulties.

yue: 好奇怪、好複雜、好難醫嘅各種病症
eng: exotic diseases or illnesses that are difficult to treat

yue: 呢位醫師專治疑難雜症。
ni1 wai2 ji1 si1 zyun1 zi6 ji4 naan4 zaap6 zing3.
eng: This doctor specialises in strange diseases.

yue: 引申為好難理解、好難解決嘅問題
eng: used figuratively to refer to problems that are difficult to understand and tackle

yue: 你有咩疑難雜症都可以問吓佢意見。
nei5 jau5 me1 ji4 naan4 zaap6 zing3 dou1 ho2 ji5 man6 haa5 keoi5 ji3 gin3.
eng: If you encounter strange problems, you can ask for his advice.

yue: 經過長時間仍然未揾到真相嘅事件（量詞：單／宗／件）
呢單十五年前嘅疑案到而家仲未有人破解到。
ni1 daan1 sap6 ng5 nin4 cin4 ge3 ji4 on3 dou3 ji4 gaa1 zung6 mei6 jau5 jan4 po3 gaai2 dou2.
eng: No one's been able to crack this fifteen-year-old case.

yue: keoi5 deoi3 nei5 hei2 zo2 ji4 sam1.
呢樣又懷疑，嗰樣又懷疑；形容人多疑，疑心重
eng: extremely suspicious; literally, suspicious of gods and ghosts

yue: 佢成日疑神疑鬼，驚死有人落毒害佢。
keoi5 seng4 jat6 ji4 san4 ji4 gwai2, geng1 sei2 jau5 jan4 lok6 duk6 hoi6 keoi5.
eng: He is very suspicious, especially afraid that someone will poison him.

yue: 人心裏面一連串積埋積埋，未解決嘅問題（量詞:個）
有冇人可以幫手解開呢個疑團？
eng: Anyone can help to clear up this suspicion?

yue: 形容人對某件事唔清唔楚，有好多問題，覺得迷惑
大家都好疑惑點解佢會無端端辭職。
daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 ji4 waak6 dim2 gaai2 keoi5 wui2 mou4 dyun1 dyun1 ci4 zik1.
eng: We are puzzled about his sudden resignation.

yue: 一件唔清楚，未肯定嘅事
政府官員陷入受賄疑雲。
zing3 fu2 gun1 jyun4 ham6 jap6 sau6 kui2 ji4 wan4.
eng: The government officers were suspected to be taking bribes.

yue: ；包括佢嘅衣着、戴啲乜嘢飾品、同埋髮型等等。
hok6 saang1 jing1 goi1 jiu3 ji4 biu2 zing2 git3.
我哋用唔同儀器嚟完成實驗。
ngo5 dei6 jung6 m4 tung4 ji4 hei3 lei4 jyun4 sing4 sat6 jim6.
eng: We make use of different apparatus in order to carry out this experiment.

yue: 外表，主要指面、髮型嘅整潔度，亦都包括衣着、飾物（量詞：副／個）
出嚟做嘢要注意下儀容。
ceot1 lai4 zou6 je5 jiu3 zyu3 ji3 haa5 ji4 jung4.
eng: It's important to maintain your appearance when working in society.

yue: 喺特定場合按程序舉行、有象徵意義嘅活動，例如係象徵過渡同轉變（量詞：個／場）
佢會負責主持呢個亮燈儀式。
keoi5 wui5 fu6 zaak3 zyu2 ci4 ni1 go3 loeng6 dang1 ji4 sik1.
eng: He will be in charge of this lighting ceremony.

yue: ni1 go3 neoi5 zai2 ji4 taai3 jau1 ngaa5.
eng: This girl has an elegant demeanor.

yue: 各類儀式或者典禮上面嘅守衞，通常係軍隊嘅一部分，但係警隊或者各個制服團體都會有
表示時間過去或者事情完成；

zho: 夜已漸荒涼，夜已漸昏暗。
je6 ji5 zim6 fong1 loeng4, je6 ji5 zim6 fan1 am3.
yue: 夜晚越嚟越荒涼，夜晚越嚟越昏暗。
je6 maan5 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 fong1 loeng4, je6 maan5 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 fan1 am3.
eng: The night is getting cold, getting darker.

yue: ngo5 ji5 ging1 soeng5 zo2 gei1.
keoi5 hai6 go3 ji5 fan1 jan4 si6.
佢同老婆分緊居，法律上仲係已婚。
keoi5 tung4 lou5 po4 fan1 gan2 geoi1, faat3 leot6 soeng6 zung6 hai6 ji5 fan1.
eng: He has been living apart from his wife, but legally he is still married.

yue: 佢唔只已婚，仲有兩個小朋友。
keoi5 m4 zi2 ji5 fan1, zung6 jau5 loeng5 go3 siu2 pang4 jau5.
eng: Not only is she married, but she also has two children.

yue: 表示時間過去、事情完成、狀態去到某一個程度
ji5 ging1 tin1 hak1 laa3, zung6 mei6 dou3 ge2?
eng: It's already getting dark. Are we there yet?

yue: man6 tai4 ji5 ging1 gaai2 kyut3.
eng: The problem has already been solved.

yue: 我同佢已經拍咗兩年拖，但係手仔都未掂過呀。
ngo5 tung4 keoi5 ji5 ging1 paak3 zo2 loeng5 nin4 to1, daan6 hai6 sau2 zai2 dou1 mei6 dim3 gwo3 aa3.
eng: We've been seeing each other for two years already, but I haven't even had the chance to hold her hand yet.

yue: 我成日都覺得已故嘅爸爸仍然係身邊。
eng: I always feel that my father is being with me like he is still alive.
(lit.) game that has already been settled or finished; (fig.) situation that has already been settled or finalized
The election result has been settled.

yue: 表示做前述嗰樣嘢，係為咗做後面嗰件事更加方便
eng: in order to; so as to

yue: 佢結婚之後住喺父母隔籬，以便互相照應。
keoi5 git3 fan1 zi1 hau6 zyu6 hai2 fu6 mou5 gaak3 lei4, ji5 bin6 wu6 soeng1 ziu3 jing3.
eng: After getting married she now lives near her parents in order to take care of them more easily.
to do sth for the sake of safety

yue: 颱風襲港期間，市民應該留喺屋企，以策安全。
toi4 fung1 zaap6 gong2 kei4 gaan1, si5 man4 jing1 goi1 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei5, ji5 caak3 on1 cyun4
eng: During a typhoon, citizens should stay at homes for the sake of safety.
before; previously; at an earlier time

yue: 以前你唔係噉㗎！你變咗喇！
ji5 cin4 nei5 m4 hai6 gam2 gaa3! nei5 bin3 zo2 laa3!
eng: You weren't like that before! You've changed!

yue: 預防或者為緊急情況作準備
eng: (of a contingency) in preparation for; in case of; so as to safeguard against

yue: 今日都係帶埋把遮出街，以防萬一落雨。
gam1 jat6 dou1 hai6 daai3 maai4 baa2 ze1 ceot1 gaai1, ji5 fong4 maan6 jat1 lok6 jyu5.
eng: I should also bring an umbrella with me, in case it rains.

yue: 喺某個地方、位置、時間或者標準之下
eng: below or after a certain point

yue: ji5 haa6 hai6 dak6 bit6 san1 man4 bou3 dou6.
eng: The following is a special news report.

yue: 喺呢一刻之後；喺某一刻之後；將來
ji5 hau6 nei5 jiu3 saang1 sing3 zou6 jan4 aa3.
eng: From now on you have to behave well.

yue: 校長、家長以及各位同學早晨。
haau6 zoeng2, gaa1 zoeng2 ji5 kap6 gok3 wai2 tung4 hok6 zou2 san4.
eng: Principal, parents and fellow students, good morning.

yue: 利用權力去謀取個人嘅利益
eng: to seek personal gain by abusing one's authority or position; to abuse power for personal advantage

yue: 呢個人以前做議員嗰陣以權謀私，坐過幾年監。
nei1 go3 jan4 ji5 cin4 zou6 ji5 jyun4 go2 zan2 ji5 kyun4 mau4 si1, co5 gwo3 gei2 nin4 gaam1.
eng: He abused his power as a Councillor for personal advantages and was put into jailed for a few years.

yue: 由過去某一個時間到而家之間
eng: period from a specific time in the past to the point of speaking ; since a specific time until now

yue: 自沙士以來，香港嘅樓價一直都冇跌過。
zi6 saa1 si2 ji5 lai4, hoeng1 gong2 ge3 lau4 gaa3 jat1 zik6 dou1 mou5 dit3 gwo3.
eng: Since SARS, the flat price in Hong Kong has never been decreased.

yue: 畢業以嚟我都冇返過學校。
bat1 jip6 ji5 lai4 ngo5 dou1 mou5 faan1 gwo3 hok6 haau6.
eng: Since graduation until now, I haven't been back to my school.
in order not to; so as not to; in order to avoid

yue: 外出要鎖好門窗，以免有財物損失。
ngoi6 ceot1 jiu3 so2 hou2 mun4 coeng1, ji5 min5 jau5 coi4 mat6 syun2 sat1.
eng: Lock the door and windows before you go out in order to avoid any loss of your property.

yue: 報復，對人哋做返佢哋傷害過你嘅嘢
eng: to punish sby by having the same thing done to them; to take revenge; (an eye for an eye); literally: a tooth for a tooth

yue: ji5 ngaa4 waan4 ngaa4, ji5 ngaan5 waan4 ngaan5
eng: an eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth

yue: 如果有人夠膽中傷我，我一定會以牙還牙。
jyu4 gwo2 jau5 jan4 gau3 daam2 zung3 soeng1 ngo5, ngo5 jat1 ding6 wui5 ji5 ngaa4 waan4 ngaa4.
eng: If someone hurts me by remark, I will definitely take revenge.
beyond a certain limit or scope

yue: 我哋正尋找旅遊業以外嘅商機。
ngo5 dei6 zing3 cam4 zaau2 leoi5 jau4 jip6 ji5 ngoi6 ge3 soeng1 gei1.
eng: We are finding new business opportunities outside of tourism.
within a certain limit or scope
not more than one hundred people

yue: 一種邏輯謬誤，片面咁根據局部嘅現象去推論事實嘅全部
呢份報紙淨係訪問咗幾個市民就總結香港人普遍支持呢個政策，真係以偏概全。
ni1 fan6 bou3 zi2 zing6 hai6 fong2 man6 zo2 gei2 go3 si5 man4 zau6 zung2 git3 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 pou2 pin3 zi1 ci4 ni1 go3 zing3 caak3, zan1 hai6 ji5 pin1 koi3 cyun4.
eng: This newspaper has only interviewed a few citizens and concluded that most of the Hong Kong people support this policy. It is a hasty generalisation.
to defy the law; to deliberately violate the law

yue: 切勿以身試法，聘用非法勞工。
cit3 mat6 ji5 san1 si3 faat3, ping3 jung6 fei1 faat3 lou4 gung1.
eng: Do not breach the law to employ illegal workers.

yue: ji5 san1 si3 faat3, hau6 gwo2 jim4 zung6.
eng: Never act in defiance of the law. The consequences could be serious.
to set oneself as a good example to others

yue: 做父母嘅應該以身作則，教導子女。
zou6 fu6 mou5 ge3 jing1 goi1 ji5 san1 zok3 zak1, gaau3 dou6 zi2 neoi5.
eng: Parents should set themselves as good examples to their children.

yue: 喺某個地方、位置、時間或者標準之上
eng: above or before a certain point

yue: 我以為今日會落雨添，點知冇！
ngo5 ji5 wai4 gam1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5 tim1, dim2 zi1 mou5!
eng: I thought it would rain today, but in the end it didn't.

yue: 今年嘅經濟比以往嗰幾年好。
gam1 nin2 ge3 ging1 zai3 bei2 ji5 wong5 go2 gei2 nin4 hou2.
eng: The economy this year is better than previous years.

yue: 表示延伸、遞進嘅範圍；後面可以帶介詞「於」
eng: (for a series of events or items) down to; up to

yue: 呢個課程內容豐富，涵蓋個人理財以至現金管理。
ni1 go3 fo3 cing4 noi6 jung4 fung1 fu3, haam4 koi3 go3 jan4 lei5 coi4 ji5 zi3 jin6 gam1 gun2 lei5.
eng: The program is comprehensive, including courses from personal finance up to cash management.

yue: 導致；造成某啲結果；表示因果關係，後面唔會帶介詞「於」
eng: so that; consequently; as a result

yue: 今個學期我冇勤力讀書，以致我考得好差。
gam1 go3 hok6 kei4 ngo5 mou5 kan4 lik6 duk6 syu1, ji5 zi3 ngo5 haau2 dak1 hou2 caa1.
eng: I didn't study hard this semester, and my exam results were poor.
(for a series of events or items) down to; up to; even

yue: 佢學識廣博，熟識天文地理、物理化學，以至於政治經濟。
keoi5 hok6 sik1 gwong2 bok3, suk6 sik1 tin1 man4 dei6 lei5, mat6 lei5 faa3 hok6, ji5 zi3 jyu1 zing3 zi6 ging1 zai3.
eng: He is so knowledgeable that he knows astronomy, geography, physics, chemistry, and even politics and economics.

yue: 係三個相連嘅器官，互相影響，所以喺醫學上會歸納埋同一科
ji5 bei6 hau4 zyun1 fo1 ji1 sang1
令人覺得唔啱聽於是刻意唔理嘅説話
eng: gibberish; meaningless words or message; nonsense; wind by the ear

yue: 你當我講嘅嘢係耳邊風？
nei5 dong3 ngo5 gong2 ge3 je5 hai6 ji5 bin1 fung1?
eng: You think what I have told you is gibberish, don't you?

yue: 泛指所有可以接駁電子發聲器材，將聲音集中引導入耳仔嘅聽筒；有啲耳機會有埋咪，可以收音（量詞：副）
佢去到邊都戴住副耳機。

干支循環通常用嚟計年份。天干亦可以獨立用嚟順序將物件命名，第一個叫「甲」、第二個叫「乙」，如此類推。用法類似西方嘅「A, B, C」 或 「α, β, γ」。中國傳統紀時間嘅方法係將一日分成十二個時辰，每一個時辰由一個地支表示，「子時」係半夜 (11pm 至 1am)，如此類推。
eng: Literally "Heavenly Stems and Earthly Branches". It is a traditional Chinese system of counting. Heavenly Stems and Earthly Branches are collectively known as "Stem-Branch".
The 10 Heavenly Stems are 甲(gaap3) 乙(jyut6) 丙(bing2) 丁(ding1) 戊(mou6) 己(gei2) 庚(gang1) 辛(san1) 壬(jam4) 癸(gwai3).

The 12 Earthly Branches are 子(zi2) 丑(cau2) 寅(jan4) 卯(maau5) 辰(san4) 巳(zi6) 午(ng5) 未(mei6) 申(san1) 酉(jau5) 戌(seot1) 亥(hoi6). Each Heavenly Stem is paired with an Earthly Branch to form the "stem-branch" sexagenary (i.e. 60 element) cycle that starts with 甲子 (gaap3 zi2)

The sexagenary cycle is often used for counting years in the Chinese calendar. Heavenly Stems are also used independently to name things in a particular order -- the first is labeled "gaap3", the second "jyut6", the third "bing2", and so on. It is similar to how "A, B, C" and "α, β, γ" are used in western cultures. Earthly Branches are also traditionally used to denote time. One day is divided into twelve slots called Chinese-hours (
), starting from 子時 (zi2 si4), which is 11pm to 1am.
